title: Pilot: short-term downgrade + feature swap
text:
Pilot: short-term downgrade + feature swap

['From: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@novamed.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot: short-term downgrade & feature swap for Novamed

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the onboarding help last month. We hit a usage blip in August and need to trim our spend for the pilot while keeping the features that matter for clinical routing. Two asks: 1) Can we temporarily reduce our plan throughput from 2M tokens/mo to 1.2M for the next 3 months (trial period)? 2) Instead of the sentiment module, we need the reranking bundle enabled — can that be swapped without changing the pilot price?

If necessary we can accept a short-term credit or prorated billing change. Would like to close before our next exec review on Sep 13.

Attached: current usage snapshot (CSV)

Best,
Olivia
Director of Product
Novamed

Attachment: novamed-current-usage.csv (CSV, 72KB)', 'From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@novamed.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: short-term downgrade & feature swap for Novamed

Hi Olivia — appreciate the heads-up and the usage file. Short answer: yes, we can accommodate a temporary throughput reduction plus a feature swap, but there are a couple of (very common) constraints around prorating and the credit terms.

Options I recommend: 
- Option A (fast): Temporary downgrade to 1.2M tokens/mo for 3 months, preserve current unit pricing, invoice prorated for Sep (we’ll adjust the next invoice). Swap sentiment -> reranking for the pilot at no extra module fee. Requires a one-paragraph amendment and billing note.
- Option B (budget-friendly): Keep throughput and apply a 20% usage credit for 3 months; feature swap included. No plan churn but impacts usage buckets.

I’ve looped Ben to confirm concession authority and Lauren for contractual wording. If you want Option A we’ll send an amendment and a DocuSign link; can turn around in 48 hours.

Quick Q: do you want the downgrade to be automatically reversed after 3 months or trigger a review?

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com

---
Attachment referenced: novamed-current-usage.csv', "From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-03T13:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Pilot: short-term downgrade & feature swap for Novamed

Folks — forwarding Novamed's ask. TL;DR: 3-month temporary downgrade from 2M -> 1.2M tokens/month and swap sentiment for reranking (no module charge). They prefer a hard downgrade (Option A) with automatic reversion at the end of the three months if usage hasn't increased.

Notes:
- Billing impact: prorate Sep, then monthly at new throughput for 3 months, then revert (auto or manual depending on your preference).
- Risk: if we auto-reinstate and usage has grown, they may hit overage in the first week after reversion — recommend a 2-week notice before reversion and a soft cap alert.

Can we sign off on: 1) one-time 0% discount but prorated billing for Sep + amendment OR 2) 25% transient discount for 3 months (reduces revenue but might secure expansion later)?

>
> Thanks again for the onboarding help last month. We hit a usage blip in August and need to trim our spend for the pilot while keeping the features that matter for clinical routing. Two asks: 1) Can we temporarily reduce our plan throughput from 2M tokens/mo to 1.2M for the next 3 months (trial period)? 2) Instead of the sentiment module, we need the reranking bundle enabled — can that be swapped without changing the pilot price?
>
> If necessary we can accept a short-term credit or prorated billing change. Would like to close before our next exec review on Sep 13.
>
> Best,
> Olivia
", 'From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-04T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Pilot: short-term downgrade & feature swap for Novamed

Mina / Lauren — I’m comfortable with Option A but think we should include a small commercial sweetener to keep momentum: 25% off usage charges for the 3-month downgrade window, then revert to their previous plan pricing. Conditions:
- Auto-reinstate after 3 months, with a 2-week warning email.
- No multi-month extension without new sign-off.
- We’ll waive the module swap fees (reranking) and ensure feature parity.

Finance note: waive any setup fees, create a one-line amendment that enumerates the effective period and reversion date. Legal can take the standard amendment template.

Ben
VP, Sales Ops
ben_carter@redwood.com', 'From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Harper <olivia.harper@novamed.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot: short-term downgrade & feature swap for Novamed

Hi Olivia — thanks for your patience. We can do the following (agreed internally):

Summary of agreed terms:
- Temporary plan change: throughput reduced from 2,000,000 -> 1,200,000 tokens/month for a 3-month period starting Sep 15, 2026 and reverting automatically on Dec 15, 2026 (we’ll send a 14-day pre-reversion notification).
- Commercial concession: 25% discount on usage charges during the 3-month window.
- Feature swap: sentiment module removed, reranking bundle enabled at no incremental module charge.
- Billing: Sep invoice prorated; amendment to be signed (DocuSign link below).

Next steps:
1) I’ve attached the one-page amendment draft. Please review and sign via DocuSign.
2) We’ll apply the prorate and discount on your Sep invoice once signed.
3) We’ll set the reversion alert and a 2-week notice to your team.

DocuSign (placeholder): https://redwood.app/docusign/ND-2026-091
Attachment: novamed-amendment-draft.pdf

If that works, I’ll route to Legal for a fast sign and to Billing to schedule the prorate.

Best,
Mina
Senior AM, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0136']
